evidence.excerpt: We introduce STEPBENCH, a benchmark of 6,885 verified procedures crawled from wikiHow across 81 open-domain categories.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Evaluating an agent's planning ability remains challenging for open-domain tasks, where verifying procedures through execution is often impractical.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
